name: Generic 8-port unmanaged desktop Ethernet switch
build: blender -b --factory-startup --python source/build_switch_generic.py, then glTF-Transform dedup → weld → meshopt (videos/_engine/hardware-3d/build.mjs)
units: metres; origin at the centre of the base; front faces +Z in three.js
lod: one level: holds from the system view to a 20 cm inspection shot
textures: none: Principled BSDF → glTF metallic-roughness; printed numbers are geometry

anchors.port_p1: port 1, centre of the opening, on the face (outward normal +Z)
anchors.led_p1: link light of port 1, above it
anchors.led_power: POWER light, left of the port row

front: ports 1–8 (RJ45, latch notch down), each with its link light above and its number printed beside it

behaviour: generic; see ../../../README.md § LED states. NO PORT IS AN UPLINK: an unmanaged switch auto-negotiates (auto MDI-X), so a film may connect the router to any of the eight. Labelling one 'uplink' would teach a rule that does not exist on this class of device.
